rules: Evidence Integration does not adjudicate deception, knowledge, Lie Ledger eligibility or Web of Lies lineage.
Preserve Pezeshkian's exact proposition before testing it.
Distinguish a claim of no civilian targeting, a claim of no attacks on civilian areas/populations, and a claim of no civilian casualties; they are not interchangeable.

factual_context: documented civilian casualty evidence already present in canonical conflict records
adjudication_requested: establish exact quoted proposition and scope
distinguish civilian-targeting intent from civilian-area attack and civilian-casualty predicates
test truth status against source-bounded casualty evidence
adjudicate knowledge only if independently supported
do_not_infer: intent to target civilians solely from the existence of civilian casualties
